messages:
Maria C (CS): FYI — ACME Corp says the enterprise promo credit from their signed contract (PO 4523) isn't reflected on their April invoice. Sales confirmed a manual grant but customer still shows a balance due. Can we get a manual ledger adjustment + PO note for audit? cc @Sam R @Priya K :eyes:
Sam R (Enterprise Sales): I created a CRM credit record (ENT-2024-PROMO, $12,000) and told ACME billing would be zeroed. I did NOT push anything to billing because I thought finance would reconcile first. My bad — what's the safe next step?
Priya K (Finance): Need invoice number and exact amount to apply manual adjustment in ledger. Also need a memo string referencing PO 4523 and the contract clause. If someone can confirm the transaction ID from the CRM credit, I'll attach it.
Jordan S (Support): Quick troubleshooting note — sometimes promo credits fail to propagate when our billing webhook errors during midnight batch. Did we get any webhook failures around 2024-04-02 00:00 UTC? If so, credits might have been queued but not applied.
l edger-bot: (automated) Found 1 matching CRM credit: ID CR-77821, amount 12000 USD, created_by sam.r, status: pending_sync. Last sync attempt: 2024-04-02T00:03:12Z, result: 502 BAD_GATEWAY.
Maria C (CS): ok that matches what customer reported. They attached a screenshot of invoice INV-2024-0427 showing $12k still due. Customer is getting nervous — please prioritize.
Akira T (Eng Oncall): I can pull logs. 502 at that time from billing ingestion — looks like the billing API timed out behind the proxy during a high-latency window. Seeing elevated latency metrics from 23:50-00:10 UTC. Could be autoscaler lag + a recently deployed timeout change.
Jordan S (Support): For immediate customer relief, finance can do a manual adjustment in the ledger and add a note: "Manual credit applied per Sales PO 4523 — CRM CR-77821." That will clear the balance and satisfy audit. Then we can follow up with a permanent sync fix. :white_check_mark:
Priya K (Finance): I'll prepare the ledger entry. Need final approval copy for Jira ticket with the audit text. Can someone paste the exact memo string and confirm who approved?
Sam R (Enterprise Sales): Approval from me — Sam R. Memo: "Apply manual credit per PO 4523 / CRM CR-77821 / ENT-2024-PROMO — approved by Sam R."
Maria C (CS): Customer confirmed they'll accept the manual adjustment today if we include PO and CRM IDs. Also requested a PO note on file for their procurement team.
Akira T (Eng Oncall): I'll create an incident ticket for the webhook 502s and assign to eng-infra. Root cause hypothesis: bursty traffic + lowered connection pool settings after last deploy. Will include logs and a repro.
Jordan S (Support): Repro steps (for ticket):
```
1) Create CRM credit CR-77821 with pending_sync flag
2) Trigger sync worker (nightly batch)
3) Observe billing.ingest endpoint returning 502 during high-latency window
4) Sync worker marks credit as pending_sync and never transitions to applied
```
Jordan S (Support): Escalation for customer-facing comms: Maria, can you confirm wording for email? I'll draft.
Maria C (CS): Draft: "We applied a manual credit of $12,000 to invoice INV-2024-0427 referencing PO 4523 and CRM ID CR-77821. This clears your outstanding balance. Our engineering team is investigating why the automated sync failed and we'll follow up with an incident summary." Send after finance posts the ledger entry.
Priya K (Finance): Ledger entry created: ADJ-2024-998, amount 12000 USD, memo: "Apply manual credit per PO 4523 / CRM CR-77821 / ENT-2024-PROMO — approved by Sam R." I will mark the invoice as settled and attach approval screenshot to the internal audit ticket.
ledger-bot: (automated) Ledger ADJ-2024-998 posted to INV-2024-0427 by priya.k at 2024-04-02T09:14:21Z.
Sam R (Enterprise Sales): Thanks all. I'll tell ACME it's done and share the approval screenshot.
Akira T (Eng Oncall): Incident created: INC-2024-312. Assigned to eng-infra. Initial note: investigate billing.ingest 502s during 2024-04-02 00:00-00:15 UTC; possible connection pool regression after deploy. I'll include logs and metrics.
Jordan S (Support): Follow-up action items: 1) Support to confirm customer sees zero balance (Maria) 2) Finance to keep audit attachments (Priya) 3) Eng to fix sync failure and add retry safety (Akira) 4) Sales to confirm PO note in CRM (Sam).
Maria C (CS): I'll confirm with ACME and update this thread when they acknowledge. :thumbsup:
Sam R (Enterprise Sales): I'll also update the CRM contact record with a PO note: "Manual credit applied ADJ-2024-998 — see invoice INV-2024-0427".
Priya K (Finance): Closing note: for future, if sales issues a CRM credit that must hit billing immediately, please flag as "urgent-sync" so finance can prioritize reconciliation.
Maria C (CS): ACME confirmed receipt and that invoice now shows $0 due. Closing here — thanks everyone. :tada:
